title: SAIC as contractor for psionic testing near Crane
summary: Jesse Michels tells of SAIC as contractor for psionic testing near Crane, about 1980s-unspecified at SAIC; Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: SAIC; Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: thinks that saic which is located right next to Naval service Warfare crane was the contractor doing the psionic testing

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that a person called Sammy believes SAIC, a large American defence contracting company, was the contractor doing psionic testing, meaning tests of supposed mind powers, in the 1980s. He says SAIC sat right next to Crane, a Navy weapons research base in Indiana. If true, it would mean a private company quietly ran experiments on psychic abilities for the military.
